quality.scope: Substantive partial intake; no complete-city or live-feed claim.
blockers: Unknown times retained as null. Verified located published intervals may be displayed as date ranges, without inferred daily sessions or time-of-day eligibility.
Multi-day intervals are not daily occurrences; map builder must preserve start/end date and opening-hour uncertainty.
Admission prices often absent; ticket availability not guaranteed.
Social discovery seeds are not readable event coverage.

quality.endTimePolicy: Only explicit source end times; never duration arithmetic.
